propositions: transition() has a split, inconsistent force-bypass surface (force: bool, separate reason param, redundant force_close) while claim() uses a unified force: str | None pattern carrying the audit reason

The transition CLI permits --reason to serve as the force-bypass note, diverging from claim which does not support this coupling and creating four internal spellings for one concept (force_reason, force_close, force_close_reason, force_plan_review)
Migration requires transition lib signature to match claim (force: str | None), removal of force: bool + force_close params, and deprecation-mapping of legacy calls via _deprecations
Internal in-memory naming must unify to force_reason across transition + claim compute paths, while retaining persisted status_data[force_close_reason] key unchanged

Guidance + help text (gates.py, txn.py, transition.py) currently shows two patterns (transition --force --reason= and claim --force=<reason>) and must be reconciled to single --force[=<reason>] everywhere
